dict.string: PapaBear Partner needs camera access to take photos for your business profile and service images. For example, you can capture and upload photos of your salon, staff, or completed services.

PapaBear Partner needs your location to help customers find your business and to show your services to nearby users. For example, when customers search for salons in their area, your business will appear in their results based on your location.

PapaBear Partner needs background location access to keep your business location updated and ensure customers can find you accurately. For example, this helps maintain your business visibility in local search results even when the app is not actively open.

PapaBear Partner needs your location to display your business to nearby customers and help them find your services. For example, customers searching for salons will see your business based on proximity to their current location.

PapaBear Partner needs access to your photo library to select and upload images for your business profile, services, and portfolio. For example, you can choose existing photos of your salon, staff members, or completed work to showcase your business.
We use tracking to provide personalized content and improve your experience.
